dict.string: TripPilot tracks your steps to display your active walking distance and exploration milestones during your journey.
TripPilot uses your camera to capture special travel memories and create polaroid snapshots of your trip.
TripPilot accesses your photo library to let you select travel moments for your polaroid album.
TripPilot saves your created polaroid memories to your photo library.
TripPilot uses Face ID to securely authenticate and unlock your personalized travel itineraries and offline travel vault.
